about: Server (5 instances seen): result of a navcloud path search, written by navcloud::PathfindingSystem::ProcessRequests / ProcessSearches next to navcloud::PathRequestComponent and navcloud::PathInternalComponent. Holds the found path (ls::DynamicArray<navcloud::NodePath>) and result flags.

evidence.says: creator bg3.exe+0x3922E10 (alloc 0x18) zeroes +0, +8 and +0xC; destructor bg3.exe+0x686280 calls the array-clear helper and frees *(comp+0). macOS ProcessSearches: the component is a DynamicArray<navcloud::NodePath> (stride 16 when appending). Live: heap pointer, capacity 0..0xD, size 0..0xD

macOS ProcessSearches writes 0x10 when the start tile is invalid, 0x20 when the goal tile is invalid, clears bit 0 (masks the flags with 0xfffffffe) when the search ends, and tests (flags & 0x7E); creator zeroes it. Live 1 (searching / done) or 0x10
not written by the Windows creator (its 8-byte store at +0xC ends at +0x14); live always 0xFFFFFFFF
